api_endpoint.description: Lago API endpoint (for example `https://api.getlago.com/api/v1`). Can also be set with `LAGO_API_ENDPOINT`.

api_key.description: Lago API key. Can also be set with `LAGO_API_KEY`.

amount_currency.description: Currency code for the add-on amount (e.g. `USD`).

code.description: Unique add-on code. Changing this forces a new resource.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the add-on code.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the add-on.

tax_codes.description: List of tax codes to apply to the add-on.

field_name.description: Field to aggregate for non-count aggregations.

values.description: Allowed values for the filter key.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the metric code.

weighted_interval.description: Interval used by weighted sum aggregation.

amount_cents.description: Discount amount in cents. Required when `coupon_type` is `fixed_amount`.

amount_currency.description: Currency code for the discount amount (e.g. `USD`). Required when `coupon_type` is `fixed_amount`.

billable_metric_codes.description: List of billable metric codes this coupon is limited to.

code.description: Unique coupon code. Changing this forces a new resource.

expiration_at.description: Expiration date and time (RFC3339). Required when `expiration` is `time_limit`.

frequency.description: Frequency at which the coupon is applied. Allowed values: `once`, `recurring`.

frequency_duration.description: Number of billing periods the coupon applies to. Required when `frequency` is `recurring`.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the coupon code.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the coupon.

percentage_rate.description: Discount percentage rate (e.g. `15.0` for 15%). Required when `coupon_type` is `percentage`.

plan_codes.description: List of plan codes this coupon is limited to. If empty, the coupon applies to all plans.

reusable.description: Whether the coupon can be applied multiple times to the same customer.

address_line1.description: First line of the customer's billing address.

address_line2.description: Second line of the customer's billing address.

invoice_grace_period.description: Grace period in days before an invoice is finalised.

payment_provider_code.description: Code of the payment provider integration.

provider_customer_id.description: Customer ID on the payment provider side.

provider_payment_methods.description: Payment methods enabled for the customer on the payment provider.

sync_with_provider.description: Whether to sync the customer with the payment provider (write-only; not read back from API).

city.description: City of the customer's billing address.

country.description: ISO 3166 country code of the customer's billing address.

external_id.description: Your application's unique identifier for the customer. Changing this forces a new resource.

finalize_zero_amount_invoice.description: Controls zero-amount invoice behaviour. Allowed values: `finalize`, `skip`, `inherit`.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the customer `external_id`.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the customer.

display_in_invoice.description: Whether to display this metadata on invoices.

metadata.description: Custom metadata attached to the customer.

address_line1.description: First line of the shipping address.

address_line2.description: Second line of the shipping address.

country.description: ISO 3166 country code of the shipping address.

state.description: State or region of the shipping address.

zipcode.description: Postal code of the shipping address.

state.description: State or region of the customer's billing address.

tax_codes.description: List of tax codes to apply to the customer.

tax_identification_number.description: Customer's tax identification number (VAT, GST, etc.).

zipcode.description: Postal code of the customer's billing address.

address_line1.description: First line of the organization's billing address.

address_line2.description: Second line of the organization's billing address.

document_locale.description: Locale used when generating invoice documents (e.g. `en`, `fr`, `de`).

invoice_footer.description: Footer text that appears on all generated invoices.

invoice_grace_period.description: Grace period in days before an invoice is finalized after its billing period ends.

city.description: City of the organization's billing address.

country.description: Country of the organization's billing address (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `US`).

default_currency.description: Default currency for the organization (ISO 4217, e.g. `USD`).

document_number_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to all generated document numbers.

document_numbering.description: Invoice document numbering scheme. Allowed values: `per_customer`, `per_organization`.

email_settings.description: Set of event types that trigger email notifications (e.g. `invoice.finalized`, `credit_note.created`).

finalize_zero_amount_invoice.description: When `true`, invoices with a zero total amount are finalized rather than voided. Note: the underlying API field uses `omitempty`, so setting this to `false` after it has been enabled may require manual adjustment in the Lago UI.

id.description: Terraform resource ID. Always set to `"organization"`.

legal_number.description: Legal registration number of the organization.

net_payment_term.description: Default net payment term in days applied to invoices.

state.description: State or region of the organization's billing address.

tax_identification_number.description: Tax identification number (VAT number) of the organization.

timezone.description: Default timezone for the organization (TZ database name, e.g. `Europe/Paris`).

zipcode.description: Postal code of the organization's billing address.

block.description: Manages the Lago organization settings. This is a singleton resource — only one instance may exist per provider configuration. `Create` calls the organization update API (upsert); `Delete` is a no-op because the organization always exists in Lago.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the plan code.

ending_at.description: End date and time for the subscription (RFC3339). When set, the subscription will be automatically terminated at this date.

external_customer_id.description: External identifier of the customer to subscribe. Changing this forces a new resource.

external_id.description: Unique external identifier for the subscription. Changing this forces a new resource.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the subscription external ID.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the subscription.

on_termination_credit_note.description: Credit note behaviour on termination. Allowed values: `credit`, `refund`, `offset`, `skip`.

on_termination_invoice.description: Invoice behaviour on termination. Allowed values: `generate`, `skip`.

plan_code.description: Code of the plan to subscribe the customer to. Can be changed in-place to trigger a plan upgrade or downgrade.

subscription_at.description: Start date and time for the subscription (RFC3339). Defaults to the current date when not set.

applied_to_organization.description: Whether this tax is automatically applied to the organization.

code.description: Unique tax code. Changing this forces a new resource.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the tax code.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the tax.

rate.description: Tax rate as a percentage (e.g. `20.0` for 20%).

credits_balance.description: Current credit balance of the wallet.

currency.description: Currency of the wallet (e.g. `USD`). Changing this forces a new resource.

expiration_at.description: Wallet expiration date and time (RFC3339). When set, the wallet will expire at this date.

external_customer_id.description: External identifier of the customer who owns this wallet. Changing this forces a new resource.

granted_credits.description: Number of free credits granted on create/top-up. Write-only — not returned by the API after creation.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the wallet Lago UUID.

invoice_requires_successful_payment.description: When `true`, invoices using wallet credits are only finalized after successful payment.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the wallet.

paid_credits.description: Number of credits purchased on create/top-up. Write-only — not returned by the API after creation.

rate_amount.description: Credit-to-currency conversion rate expressed as a decimal string (e.g. `"1.0"`).

expiration_at.description: Expiration date and time for the recurring rule (RFC3339).

granted_credits.description: Number of free credits to grant on each top-up.

invoice_requires_successful_payment.description: When `true`, invoices for this rule's top-up are only finalized after successful payment.

lago_id.description: Lago UUID for this recurring transaction rule. Required when updating an existing rule.

paid_credits.description: Number of paid credits to add on each top-up.

started_at.description: Start date and time for the recurring rule (RFC3339).

threshold_credits.description: Credit balance threshold that triggers a top-up when the `trigger` is `threshold`.

trigger.description: What triggers the top-up. Allowed values: `interval`, `threshold`.

recurring_transaction_rules.description: List of rules that automatically top up the wallet on a schedule or threshold.

block.description: Manages a Lago prepaid wallet for a customer.

id.description: Terraform resource ID, set to the webhook endpoint Lago UUID.

lago_id.description: Lago internal UUID for the webhook endpoint.

signature_algo.description: Algorithm used to sign webhook payloads. Allowed values: `jwt`, `hmac`.

webhook_url.description: URL to which Lago will send webhook events. Changing this forces a new resource.
